format: html

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
```

## Compare Any Name to "Braden"

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("data/comparison_names.csv").csv({ typed: true })

viewof searchName = Inputs.text({
  label: "Search a name to compare:",
  value: "Brandon",
  placeholder: "Type a name (e.g., Brandon, Brayden, Liam, Emma, Noah)..."
})

cleaned = searchName.trim().toLowerCase()
displayName = searchName.trim() ? searchName.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() + searchName.trim().slice(1).toLowerCase() : "Comparison"

filtered = data.filter(d => 
  d.name.toLowerCase() === cleaned || 
  d.name === "Braden"
)

Plot.plot({
  title: `Popularity Comparison: "${displayName}" vs. "Braden" (1924–2023)`,
  y: { grid: true, label: "Total Births" },
  x: { tickFormat: "d", label: "Year" },
  color: { 
    legend: true,
    domain: ["Braden", displayName],
    range: ["#0284c7", "#ec4899"]
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(filtered, {
      x: "year", 
      y: "count", 
      stroke: d => d.name === "Braden" ? "Braden" : displayName, 
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.tip(filtered, Plot.pointerX({
      x: "year", 
      y: "count", 
      title: d => `${d.name} (${d.year}): ${d.count.toLocaleString()} births`
    }))
  ]
})
```

## "Braden" Deep Dive

```{r}
#| label: plot-braden
#| message: false
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "^yob.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

baby_names <- read_csv(
  files,
  id = "file",
  col_names = c("name", "sex", "count"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(year = parse_number(basename(file))) |>
  select(year, sex, name, count)


# Filter for Braden over the last 100 years and format labels
braden <- baby_names |>
  filter(name == "Braden", year >= 1924) |>
  mutate(sex_label = if_else(sex == "M", "Male", "Female"))

p1 <- ggplot(braden, aes(
    x = year,
    y = count,
    color = sex_label,
    fill = sex_label,
    group = sex_label,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>Year:</b> ", year, "<br>",
      "<b>Sex:</b> ", sex_label, "<br>",
      "<b>Babies:</b> ", comma(count)
    )
  )) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.25, position = "identity") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#ec4899", "Male" = "#0284c7")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#ec4899", "Male" = "#0284c7")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1930, 2020, by = 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name 'Braden' (1924–2023)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplotly(p1, tooltip = "text") |>
  add_annotations(
    x = 2008,
    y = 2524,
    text = "I was born here",
    showarrow = TRUE,
    arrowhead = 2,
    arrowsize = 1,
    arrowwidth = 1.5,
    arrowcolor = "#ef4444",
    ax = 45,
    ay = -40,
    font = list(size = 12, color = "#1e293b"),
    bgcolor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)",
    bordercolor = "#cbd5e1",
    borderwidth = 1,
    borderpad = 4
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: hist-braden
#| message: false
p2 <- ggplot(braden, aes(
    x = year,
    y = count,
    fill = sex_label,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>Year:</b> ", year, "<br>",
      "<b>Sex:</b> ", sex_label, "<br>",
      "<b>Births:</b> ", comma(count)
    )
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#ec4899", "Male" = "#0284c7")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1930, 2020, by = 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual 'Braden' Births by Year (1924–2023)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Births",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplotly(p2, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(tickformat = "d"))
```

```{r}
#| label: scatter-braden
#| message: false
p3 <- ggplot(braden, aes(
    x = year,
    y = count,
    color = sex_label,
    size = count,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>Year:</b> ", year, "<br>",
      "<b>Sex:</b> ", sex_label, "<br>",
      "<b>Births:</b> ", comma(count)
    )
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#ec4899", "Male" = "#0284c7")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 6), labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1930, 2020, by = 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual 'Braden' Births Scatterplot (1924–2023)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Births",
    color = "Sex",
    size = "Births"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplotly(p3, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(tickformat = "d"))
```
